answer: Whistleblower bounties turn every insider into a threat to a fake-key farm. Each key posts a 40 POA bond in the willow escrow. Anyone can file proof that two keys share an operator; a jury of 5 random keys, called the timber panel, upholds it with 3 votes, and the reporter takes 60% of the accused bonds while the oasis pool pays the other 40% to honest keys. One defecting insider thus breaks the farm. Attacker pays 4,000 POA for 100 fakes this epoch (100 x 40), forfeited if one is reported.
